_comment: p8 re-scrape (replaces cmq48g609). The original heroes leaked the supplier presentation box and drifted one variant's metal bracelet to a black rubber/leather strap. These notes are appended with highest priority by buildHeroPrompt() to force a bare, bracelet-faithful watch hero.
heroPromptExtraNotes: CRITICAL: Render ONLY the bare wristwatch alone on the pale beige studio cove — NOTHING else in the frame. ABSOLUTELY NO presentation box, gift box, watch box, jewelry box, packaging, case, display stand, acrylic stand, pillow, cushion, watch roll, or holder of ANY kind. If the reference image shows the watch inside or beside a box, IGNORE the box entirely and extract ONLY the watch. BAND FIDELITY: this watch has a brushed/polished stainless-steel bracelet (metal links) as shown in the reference — preserve that steel bracelet EXACTLY; do NOT replace, recolor, or restyle it as a rubber, silicone, leather, or fabric strap. Keep the dial color, luminous hands, markers, and any printed dial text legible and identical to the reference.
